# Lane & Associates Family Dentistry

> A comprehensive family dental practice network with 50+ locations across North Carolina offering general, cosmetic, pediatric, and specialty dental services.

Lane & Associates has been serving North Carolina families for over 40 years with a team of experienced dentists and specialists. The practice operates multiple locations across the state including Raleigh, Durham, Greensboro, Cary, and other NC communities, providing accessible dental care with online appointment scheduling and patient-friendly services.

## Key Topics

- Family Dentistry
- North Carolina Dental Practice
- General Dentistry
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Preventive Care
- Teeth Whitening
- Invisalign
- Porcelain Veneers
- Dental Cleanings
- Multi-Location Practice
- New Patient Services
- Medicaid Accepted
- Appointment Scheduling
